ns2:course.label: Grp Instr Pno for Mus Maj III
ns2:course.description: (MUSIC 162) Intermediate group instruction in piano for music majors whose principal performing medium is voice, or an orchestral or band instrument. Continuation of skills introduced in MUS 173. Study of intermediate level solos and ensemble compositions, harmonization with chromatic chords, sight reading, transposition of four-voice works, improvisation, and learning of patriotic songs. Prerequisite: MUS 102, MUS 108; MUS 173 or equivalent; consent of instructor.
